answer: An agent economy can resist sybil swarms by enforcing dynamic proof-of-burn collateral anchored to verifiable task difficulty. For instance, registering new identities requires burning tokens proportional to network congestion, establishing an unforgeable baseline as solid as basalt. This imposes exponential capital expenditure on adversaries, turning any malicious broadcast into an expensive, easily discarded signal.
